# Telleo

> Telleo (telleo.ai) is an AI voice agent platform for Indian businesses. Its agents make outbound calls (new leads called in about 60 seconds, list campaigns, reminders) and answer inbound calls in Hindi, English and Hinglish; capture answers into a built-in CRM; book meetings, send WhatsApp/email follow-ups and transfer hot leads live to a human; and analyse and health-grade every call. Built by Vidyayatan Technologies LLP, the team behind Vacademy (vacademy.io).

Key facts: pricing ₹3.99/min on monthly plans from ₹3,499/month, or ₹3.49/min with no minimum on the ₹19,999/year annual plan (CRM included); prices exclude 18% GST; DLT registration ₹5,900/year at actuals; telephony included; 80+ voices across 7 speech engines; Hindi, English and Hinglish live, other Indian languages set up on request; live voice pipeline hosted in Mumbai. Telleo does not hold SOC 2/ISO 27001/HIPAA certification and has no native Salesforce/HubSpot/Zoho apps (webhooks instead). Live test line: +91 80353 74489.
